steps.title: Flash Freeze Tissue
steps.instruction: Immediately flash freeze resected tissue by placing it into a 50 ml Falcon tube or 2 ml cryovial tube and dropping the filled tube into liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Store Frozen Tissue
steps.instruction: Store the tubes on dry ice or at -80°C until they can be transferred to a liquid nitrogen tank.

steps.title: Pulverize Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize the desired amount of tissue (30mg - 60mg) using a freezing cold mortar and pestle with liquid nitrogen to prevent thawing.

substeps.instruction: Smash large tissue pieces in the mortar and pestle with liquid nitrogen.
Sweep the pulverized tissue into a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube sitting on dry ice.

steps.title: Lyse and Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Lyse and homogenize the tissue using RLT buffer containing beta-mercaptoethanol.

substeps.instruction: Use an 18 gauge needle to homogenize until the needle runs smoothly.
If the lysed tissue in RLT appears yellow rather than clear, dilute with additional RLT buffer to ensure it can run through columns without loss of material.

steps.title: Elute and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA in water and freeze at -80°C.
